cause: The generated workflow passed the wrong reservation identifier downstream: inventory/reserve was called for order-17 and its prelude source returns reservation_id "reservation:" plus the order_id, but shipping/schedule was generated with reservation_id "order-17". The shipping source only preserves the supplied identifier, so the evidence establishes the value mismatch but does not identify a responsible component for the workflow-generated argument.
evidence: The execution_errors item records kind workflow_failed, reason explicit_failure, and evaluation_id workflow-evaluation-1.
The inventory prelude source defines reserve to return reservation_id (str "reservation:" (get request "order_id")), yielding reservation:order-17 for that request.
The shipping prelude source defines schedule to return the supplied reservation_id unchanged, confirming it cannot correct the mismatched order-17 argument.
